detail.title: Predictive Processing and Temporal Expectations in Musical Experience
detail.summary: WAKE has activated `proj-music-004` to synthesize evidence regarding predictive dynamics in music. The synthesis leverages existing scholarly records on the Action Simulation for Auditory Prediction (ASAP) hypothesis and active interoceptive inference frameworks to model musical engagement. Findings indicate that musical structure functions as a temporal template, where listeners minimize prediction error through continuous monitoring of rhythmic and harmonic cues. This confirms that musical experience is an active, generative process of temporal expectation rather than passive acoustic absorption.
